## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete outcome and link the execution ticket / F- or NFR- requirement.

## Validation

List commands actually run and results. State any checks not run and why.

## Review considerations

Describe applicable authorization/privacy, accessibility, data migration, API/mobile compatibility, and operational impacts. Include synthetic-data screenshots for UI changes and evaluation evidence for matching changes.

## Rollout and remaining decisions

Describe deployment/rollback implications, feature flags, known limitations and unresolved decision IDs. This template does not grant merge or deployment permission.
